title: What If You Could Feel Earth's Magnetic Field?
description:
Imagine always knowing which way is north. In a forest, in a city you've never visited, in total darkness. Birds and sea turtles navigate with Earth's magnetic field, and a 2019 Caltech experiment suggests your own brain might be reacting to it right now.

Would you trade your phone's map for a built-in compass? Tell me in the comments 👇

▶ More What Ifs: What If You Had a Shark's Sixth Sense?
